_comment: Default commits resolved when no explicit branch/hash is supplied. Update these after verifying a build passes with a newer commit.

_provenance.susfs_android15-6.6_KSU: simonpunk/susfs4ksu gki-android15-6.6 -> f98f0822 (2026-11-15), SUSFS_VERSION 'v2.4.0'. Verified by full CI build (run 44012089375, all 7 variants green, log shows 'SusFS Version: v2.4.0').
_provenance.susfs_android15-6.6_KSUN: be7b7ef4 = SUSFS v2.2.0. The v2.4.0 KSUN fix set does not fit KernelSU-Next (CI run 44007359941 left rejects in kernel/core/init.c 6/8, sucompat.c 2/4, supercall/dispatch.c 2/9 and four more files), so KSUN stays on v2.2.0.
_provenance.ksu_main: tiann/KernelSU main f49be695 (2026-11-17). Verified two ways: (a) SUSFS v2.4.0's 106-hunk enable patch applies with zero rejects; (b) full CI build run 44012089375 produced 'KernelSU Version: 32731' artifacts for all seven variants.
_provenance.ksu_dev: KernelSU-Next dev 234f6e04 (2026-08-10). VERIFIED, not guessed: the KSUN path applies the v2.2.0 enable patch best-effort (6 rejects), then repairs each with fix_<file>.patch from next/susfs_fix_patches/v2.2.0/ (Kbuild, init.c, kernel_umount.c, sucompat.c, setuid_hook.c, supercall.c), then overwrite_hook_mode + ksu_toolkit -- leaving ZERO rejects. A version bump to 7ccf6147 was tried and broke this: 53 failed hunks and no fix set covers them.
_provenance.why_paired: The susfs pins are keyed per KSU variant because each flavour tracks the susfs sync at a different point. The two paths are structurally different: KSU applies cleanly on its own and needs no fix set at v2.4.0, while KSUN always relies on the fix-patch repair loop.
_provenance.history: Original repo pins were KSU=937215c / KSUN=be7b7ef / dev=234f6e04, all at SUSFS v2.2.0. This revision moves ONLY KSU to v2.4.0 (KSU commit f49be695) and leaves KSUN/dev untouched, because that is the configuration proven by CI. An intermediate revision bumped dev to 7ccf6147 on the assumption that newer is better; it broke KSUN and was reverted.
